# What Is Responsive Design?

#### Course: Make Your Code Work on Every Screen

## What Is Responsive Design?

So what does responsive design actually mean?

Think about it this way. You have one HTML file and one CSS file. You open it on your laptop and it looks great.

You open it on your phone and it falls apart. Same files, same code, totally different experience.

What if the layout could just adjust on its own?

No separate mobile version. No rewriting anything. Just the page adapting to fit whatever screen it lands on.

That's responsive design.

And here's something worth thinking about. Most web traffic today comes from phones. So a site that only works on a wide screen is already losing most of its visitors before they've read a single word.

![Same HTML, different layout](data:application/octet-stream;base64,)

That split up there? Same HTML. Same CSS. Just a different screen width.

That's exactly what we're building toward.
